items.name: .300 Blackout AP
items.desc: A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) AP cartridge loaded with an 8.4 gram armor-piercing bullet from a 7.62x51mm NATO M80A1 cartridge, composed of a steel penetrator tip over a copper alloy core with a copper semi-jacket in a brass case. Despite the bullet's own characteristics when used in a full-power cartridge, these are affected when transferred to an intermediate cartridge, however, the bullet continues to have capabilities to pierce basic and intermediate body ballistic protections, in addition to being able to cause substantial adverse effects on the target after impact. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any issues.

items.name: .300 Blackout AP ammo pack (50 pcs)
items.desc: A pack of .300 Blackout AP ammo, 50 rounds.

items.name: .300 Blackout BCP FMJ
items.desc: A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) BCP FMJ cartridge with a 9.4 gram lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a steel case; intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice, produced by Barnaul Cartridge Plant. Thanks to its rudimentary design, this cartridge is one of the most economical options of its caliber, and despite this, it has capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protection, as well as certain intermediate models, in addition to providing a significant stopping power effect. However, it has a significant bounce probability on various surfaces. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any problem.

items.name: .300 Blackout BCP FMJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
items.desc: A box of .300 Blackout BCP FMJ cartridges, 50 pieces.

Despite the bullet's own characteristics when used in a full-power cartridge, these are affected when transferred to an intermediate cartridge, still, the bullet continues to have capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models. However, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any issues.

items.name: .300 Blackout V-Max
items.desc: A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) V-Max cartridge with a 7.1 gram lead core polymer tipped expansive bullet with a copper metal jacket, in a brass case. This bullet features a ballistic tip that improves its accuracy and acts as a wedge on the lead core upon impact, allowing the bullet to expand and cause considerable damage on the target. Despite the peculiarity of its design, it is able to pierce basic ballistic body protections. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any problem.

items.name: .300 Whisper
items.desc: The Whisper cartridge is a lightweight, hyper velocity design using an aluminum core and pre-stressed jacket. The cartridge is ideal for close fire contacts of unarmored and/or lightly armored targets. Not to be mistaken for .300 Blackout, since Whisper was developed almost 20 years before it.

items.desc: A 9x21mm Gyurza BT gzh (SP13, GRAU Index - 7BT3) cartridge with a 7.3 gram armor-piercing tracer bullet with a steel core and a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a bimetallic case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). This BT bullet (Bronebóynaya Trassíruyushchaya - "Armor-piercing Tracer") was developed for 9x21mm caliber submachine guns by TsNIITochMash based on the 9x21mm PS gzh "SP10" cartridge and has superior characteristics, being able of piercing basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, as well as having a considerable stopping power effect, however, it has a high bounce probability on various surfaces.

items.name: 9x21mm P gzh
items.desc: A 9x21mm Gyurza P gzh (SP11, GRAU Index - 7N28) cartridge with a 7.5 gram soft lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was designed by TsNIITochMash due to the need to create a cheaper 9x21mm PS gzh "SP10" cartridge for practice shooting during experimentation with weapons of the same caliber. Because of this, the cartridge had to meet similar criteria, such as recoil, muzzle velocity, and trajectories. The result was so satisfactory that it was adopted by the FSB due to its considerable stopping power effect.

This cartridge was developed by TsNIITochMash due to the needs of the FSB to equip its special forces with a cartridge capable of granting outstanding stopping power effects at distances up to 200 meters and maintaining similar criteria to its counterparts of the same caliber, such as recoil, muzzle velocity, and trajectories.

items.name: 9x21mm PS gzh

This cartridge was designed in the 1990s by TsNIITochMash to provide superior penetration capabilities compared to its standard 9x19mm counterparts, being capable of piercing basic ballistic body protection equipment and some intermediate models, however, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

This BP cartridge (Bronebóynaya Púlya - "Armor-piercing Bullet") was developed in the early 2000s based on the 9x39mm SP-6 cartridge to improve its design and penetration capabilities, resulting in an improvement at piercing most models of specialized ballistic body protections, in addition to provide a significant stopping power effect. However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

The PAB-9 (Patrón Avtomátnyy Bronebóynyy - "Armor-piercing Cartridge for Automatic rifles") is a modified version of the SP-6 cartridge. It has a heavier bullet and a higher muzzle velocity, making it capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition of providing outstanding results against some specialized protection models, and having a considerable stopping power effect, at the cost of deterioration in its accuracy and having a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces. Being capable of piercing through basic ballistic body protections as well as certain intermediate protection equipment, added to its outstanding stopping power effect, however, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

items.name: Balaclava (Skull)

items.name: Balaclava (Zaebtsa)

items.desc: You can call it a green beret, but it's definitely an Olive Drab beret.

items.name: Big Pipe's bandana

items.name: Big Pipe's smoking pipe
items.desc: A smoking pipe owned by one of the commanders of the Rogues - Big Pipe.

items.name: Black Division encryption keys

items.desc: The LShZ-2DTM helmet is intended for periodic wearing with the purpose of protection from bullets of small arms of a user’s head, as well as for protection from bullets of small arms of a user’s face and neck when equipped with a visor and aventail.

items.name: BNTI Module-3M body armor
items.desc: A lightweight bulletproof vest of class 2 of GOST-R protection, used by private security companies and collection services.

items.name: BNTI Zhuk body armor (Press)
items.desc: An armored vest for journalists working in combat zones.

items.name: Body armor repair kit
items.desc: A bag with everything you need to repair body armor - from the lightest to the heaviest.

items.name: Bogatyr squad operations report
items.desc: The documents describe several operations carried out by the Bogatyr squad.

items.name: Bolts
items.desc: Bolts, together with screw nuts, are used to fasten things in place. An essential item for organizing a Hideout.

items.name: Bomber beanie
items.desc: A heraldic symbol of urban vagabonds. You need to wear it correctly, otherwise, the magic properties of the beanie will cease to work.

items.name: Book of the Arrival
items.desc: A homemade book filled with notes and drawings about witnesses of the Arrival, The Unheard, and the end of the old world.

items.name: Boreas scientist audio tape
items.desc: An audio tape recovered from Compartment C-3, containing a message left behind by the last survivor about the icebreaker "Boreas".

items.name: BOSS cap
items.desc: A fancy red BOSS cap. Yo, fella, you da real BOSS now!

items.name: Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
items.desc: The most popular whiskey among the PMCs. The unique filtration of the drink occurs through charcoal obtained from the burning of Samara sugar birch. This is an alcohol drink, and alcohol is harmful. Especially for such a warrior like you.

items.name: Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
items.desc: A first-class moonshine straight from the Hideout. Sixfold distillation, purification, crystallization, and ionization of the boiling process led to the creation of this 79-degree drink. Remember that drinking alcohol can lead to tragic consequences.

items.name: Bottle of hydrogen peroxide
items.desc: Hydrogen peroxide is used in medicine as a cleaning and antiseptic treatment for wounds.

items.name: Bottle of Norvinsky Yadreniy premium kvass (0.6L)
items.desc: Norvinsky Premium, a truly refreshing kvass. Kvass is made by the natural fermentation of bread, such as wheat, rye, or barley, and sometimes flavoured using fruit, berries, raisins, or birch sap. One of the traditional Slavic drinks, it is not just a tasty, but also a healthy product. It is for a reason that in Russian tales it is constantly drunk by Bogatyrs to regain their power.

items.name: Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins
items.desc: A bottle with multivitamins. A demanded item in conditions of reduced immunity.

items.name: Bottle of Pevko Light beer
items.desc: Mmmmm... Pevko. The legendary drink of the streets of Tarkov.

items.name: Bottle of saline solution
items.desc: Physiological saline solution, whose osmotic pressure is equal to the osmotic pressure of the blood. There are several types of physiological solutions, the composition of which depends on the purposes for which they are applied.

items.name: Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
items.desc: "Tarkov fire water". It is not recommended to consume it in general, alcohol is harmful and all that, but sometimes it is necessary to relax after the battle. No need to raid area 51 to see them aliens after all.

items.name: Bottle of water (0.6L)
items.desc: A 0.6 liter bottle of water. The bottle itself might be a bit dirty, but the water is clean. Hopefully.

items.name: Bottle of YMXC water
items.desc: A bottle of water from the limited-edition YMXC series released to commemorate the first international marathon held in Tarkov. The race was won by a runner from China, who was the first to reach the finish line at the southern port terminal.

items.name: Briefcase with documents
items.desc: An unremarkable, inexpensive briefcase containing documents clearly never meant for anyone else's eyes. It seems one TerraGroup employee decided to hide important papers in the most obvious place possible — where no one would ever think to look.

items.name: Broken GPhone smartphone
items.desc: GPhone 9s - one of the previous generations of the famous smartphone model. Shattered beyond repair.

items.name: Broken GPhone X smartphone
items.desc: The last thing that Wepple managed to release on the smartphone market. Broken and unusable, but contains a lot of useful components.

items.name: Broken LCD
items.desc: A damaged liquid crystal display. Contains a lot of useful microelectronic parts.

items.name: Bronze lion figurine
items.desc: A collectible bronze lion figure. The thing is heavy, seemingly beautiful. Useful either for sale or aesthetic pleasure.

items.name: BT10 V8 Atlas Bipod
items.desc: The Atlas V8 series BT10 bipod. Lightweight, foldable, adjustable. Manufactured by B&T Industries L.L.C.

items.name: BTR figurine
items.desc: A collectible figurine from an unknown creator, showcasing the best means of transportation in all of Tarkov.

items.name: Bulbex cable cutter
items.desc: A high-quality lever cable cutting tool. It is used for the installation and laying of cable routes and power lines.

items.name: Bundle of wires
items.desc: Pieces of various purpose wires. Might be usable for electronic purposes.

items.name: Burnt document
items.desc: A burnt document, barely legible.

items.name: Burris AR-P.E.P.R. 30mm ring scope mount
items.desc: The Burris P.E.P.R. universal 30mm scope base mount for installation on Picatinny rails.

items.name: Burris FastFire 3 reflex sight
items.desc: Light and tough, the FastFire series collimator puts a clear bright red dot on your target to give you an immediate speed and accuracy advantage. Can be used as a primary sight or mounted on top of an existing sight.

items.name: Burris FastFire Weaver Base
items.desc: This base from Burris allows to mount the compact FastFire Series Sights to Weaver or Picatinny-style rails.

items.name: Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope
items.desc: The TAC30 offers a very wide field of view, and 1x magnification at the lower end - making for easy, fast target acquisition. The 4x full zoom and Ballistic CQ reticle make shots out to about 300 yards very practical. The illuminated center dot and large, bright circle allow for instant target engagement at close distances.

items.name: CALOK-B hemostatic applicator
items.desc: The CALOK-B applicator hemostatic agent allows you to inject hemostatic granules through a wound opening directly to the source of bleeding in just a few seconds.

items.name: Camelbak Tri-Zip assault backpack (Foliage)
items.desc: A Mid-sized versatile assault pack. Spacious, sturdy and comfortable, this backpack is loved both by military and hikers worldwide. 34L of total space, a hydration system, easy access to side pockets, near-perfect suspension, and a MOLLE attachment system make it a great choice for up to 72 hours of autonomous hiking... or carrying a good load of loot.

items.name: Camelbak Tri-Zip assault backpack (MultiCam)
items.desc: A Mid-sized versatile assault pack. Spacious, sturdy and comfortable, this backpack is loved both by military and hikers worldwide. 34L of total space, a hydration system, easy access to side pockets, near-perfect suspension, and a MOLLE attachment system make it a great choice for up to 72 hours of autonomous hiking... or carrying a good load of loot. MultiCam camouflage version.

items.name: Camper axe
items.desc: A universal travel axe for use in field conditions or in household. Also works as a melee weapon if things get too desperate.

items.name: Can of beef stew (Large)
items.desc: A large amount of canned beef stew, commonly referred to as "tushonka", can be stored for years, thus rivaling condensed milk in importance as a food supply for both military and tourists.

items.name: Can of beef stew (Small)
items.desc: A small amount of canned beef stew, commonly referred to as "tushonka", can be stored for years, thus rivaling condensed milk in importance as a food supply for both military and tourists.

items.name: Can of condensed milk
items.desc: Condensed milk, also called "Sguschyonka" in Russia, once was a part of field ration for the Union soldiers in Civil War, but later reached unprecedented popularity in post-Soviet countries, becoming almost a staple product. Canned, it can be stored for decades and remain just as sweet, tasty and nutritious.

items.name: Can of Dr. Lupo's coffee beans
items.desc: The famous Dr.Lupo's huge coffee beans. They are humongous! The roasting is as hardcore as possible, definitely will hit hard.

items.name: Can of duck pate
items.desc: A spreadable meat product made from cooked ingredients, produced by Norvinsk Poultry Plant. No ducks were harmed in the making. Probably.

items.name: Can of GigaBeef meat
items.desc: A special edition, oversized can of GigaBeef, made to a traditional British recipe. Some say a meal of this quality even helps you think more clearly… though results may vary.

items.name: Can of green peas
items.desc: Can of green peas, rich in vitamins and selenium, which makes it especially valuable in the dubious environmental conditions of the Norvinsk region.

items.name: Can of herring
items.desc: Canned herring, probably the lightest meal among canned fish, is rich with calcium and magnesium.

items.name: Can of Hot Rod energy drink
items.desc: Hot Rod, though being the most recognizable energy drink in the world, is not much more powerful than its counterparts. The standards are the same for all.

items.name: Can of humpback salmon
items.desc: A can of humpback salmon, a tasty source of aliphatic acids and niacin.

items.name: Can of Ice Green tea

items.name: Colt M16A1 5.56x45 assault rifle
items.desc: An American-made 5.56x45mm assault rifle developed by Colt in the late 1960s as an improved variant of the original AR-15/M16 design. The M16A1 became the standard service rifle of the US military during the Vietnam War, featuring a forward assist and other refinements for reliability in harsh conditions. Though considered outdated by modern standards, it remains a durable and accurate weapon prized by collectors and shooters alike.

items.name: Colt M16A2 5.56x45 assault rifle
items.desc: A later evolution of the M16 platform, the M16A2 introduced a burst-fire mechanism, improved iron sights, handguard and buttstock for greater control and durability. Chambered for 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, it served as the primary service rifle for the U.S. military throughout the 1980s and 1990s. Known for its precision and dependability, the M16A2 remains a benchmark for modern assault rifle design.

items.name: Colt M1911A1 .45 ACP pistol
items.desc: Commonly known as just "1911", the M1911 is one of the most famous handguns on the planet. It went through both World Wars as the US Army's standard-issue, and despite being replaced in 1986, its further variations are still being used as the sidearm of different US Special Forces. The M1911A1 is the second generation of the original M1911 pistol. After World War I, the military's Model 1911 went through various changes including a shorter trigger with frame cuts, improved iron sights, an arched mainspring housing, and a redesigned grip safety.

items.name: Colt M45A1 .45 ACP pistol
items.desc: The MEU(SOC) pistol, ("Marine Expeditionary Unit"; "Special Operations Capable") officially designated the M45 MEUSOC, is a magazine-fed, recoil-operated, single-action, semiautomatic pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It's a variant of the M1911, and has been the standard-issue side arm for the Force Recon Element of the United States Marine Corps' Marine Expeditionary Units since 1985. The improved M45A1 features several changes to the original M1911A1 design. One feature is the dual recoil spring system that spreads out the recoil force of the .45 ACP round by lowering the peak force of the recoil pulse. It also has 3-dot tritium night sights, a 5-inch national match barrel, ambidextrous safety, a picatinny rail, and a desert tan Cerakote finish.

items.name: Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle
items.desc: The Colt M4A1 carbine is a fully automatic variant of the basic M4 Carbine and was primarily designed for special operations use. However, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) was soon to adopt the M4A1 for almost all special operations units, followed later by general introduction of the M4A1 into service with the U.S. Army and Marine Corps.

This feature, combined with a sharp false edge, makes the knife retain sufficient combat penetration capability to engage targets covered in heavy clothing, padding, or soft ballistic protections. items.name: Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AK-104 7.62x39mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base, more precisely a shortened version of AK-103. A short compact version equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-105 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AK-105 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base. A short compact version equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45 automatic rifle is the primary model of individual small arms for personnel of motorized and other units of the Russian Armed Forces. The AK-12 is a part of the Ratnik equipment system.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle
items.desc: A variant of the Kalashnikov assault rifle designed for export to countries whose armies continue to use the 7.62x51 NATO (.308 Win) cartridge as their standard infantry small arms ammunition. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-74 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AK-74 (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74") 5.45x39mm assault rifle, developed in 1970 by М. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of the AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The AK-74 was equipped with a new buttstock, handguard (which retained the AKM-type finger swells), and gas cylinder. The stock has a shoulder pad different from that on the AKM, which is rubber and serrated for improved seating against the shooter. In addition, there are lightening cuts on each side of the buttstock. The buttstock, lower handguard, and upper heatguard were first manufactured from laminated wood, this later changed to a synthetic, plum or dark brown colored fiberglass.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-74M 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AK-74M (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Modernizirovanny - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Modernized") 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a full-scale produced modernized version of the AK-74 that offers more versatility compared with its predecessor. Apart from several minor improvements, such as a lightened bolt and carrier assembly to reduce the impulse of the gas piston and bolt carrier during firing, the rifle features a new glass-filled polyamide stock that retains the shape of the original AK-74 fixed laminated wood stock, but side-folds to the left like the skeletonised AKS-74 buttstock, and also a dovetail side mount for installing various scopes. The AK-74M is a main service rifle of the Russian Federation.

items.name: Kalashnikov AK-74N 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AK-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night") was developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The key design difference from the standard AK-74 is a side mount for optical and night scopes.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AKM (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny - Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Modernised) 7.62x39mm automatic rifle was adopted in 1959 to replace AK as a standard service weapon of the Soviet Army. Main differences compared to AK: enhanced accuracy range, lower weight, new stock, trigger, hammer retarder, muzzle compensator, and other design changes aimed at improving the efficiency of the rifle.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKMN 7.62x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKMN (Avtomat Kalashnikova Modernizirovanny Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Modernised Night") is a small arms system consisting of a modified AKM automatic rifle with a dovetail mount for installation of the NSP family night vision scopes — NSP-2/3/3A, NSPU, NSPU-M.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKMS 7.62x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKMS (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny Skladnóy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle Modernised with foldable stock") 7.62x39 assault rifle (GRAU Index — 6P4) is a variant of the AKM rifle with a folding shoulder piece (stock). Folds forward-down, under the handguard. Designed specifically for airborne troops.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKMSN 7.62x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKMSN 7.62x39 (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny Skladnóy Nochnóy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle Modernised Night with a foldable stock") is a modified AKMS automatic rifle with a dovetail mount for installation of the NSP family night vision scopes — NSP-2/3/3A, NSPU, NSPU-M.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: The AKS-74 (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 with a foldable stock") 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a variant of AK-74 equipped with a side-folding metal shoulder stock, designed primarily for use with air assault infantry and developed alongside the basic AK-74. The AKS-74 stock is fabricated from stamped sheet metal struts, machine pressed into a "U" shape and assembled by punch fit and welding.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74N 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKS-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night with foldable stock") 5.45x39mm assault rifle equipped with a side-folding metal shoulder stock, designed primarily for use with air assault infantry. The key design difference from the standard AKS-74 is a side dovetail mount for optical and night scopes.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74U 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKS-74U (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 Ukorochenny - "Kalashnikov's Shortened Automatic rifle 74 with a foldable stock") is a shortened version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed in the early 80s for combat vehicle crews and airborne troops, also became very popular with law enforcement and special forces for its compact size.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74UB 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: A special version of the AKS-74U assault rifle, modification B (Besshumny - "Silenced") is issued with a dovetail scope mount, a sound suppressor device, and special sights designed for firing subsonic ammunition.

items.name: Kalashnikov AKS-74UN 5.45x39 assault rifle
items.desc: AKS-74UN (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 Ukorochenny Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Shortened Automatic rifle 74 Night with a foldable stock") is a shortened version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed in the early 80s for combat vehicle crews and airborne troops, also became very popular with law enforcement and special forces for its compact size. The N (Nochnoy - "Night") version is equipped with a dovetail mount for the installation of night vision scopes.

items.name: Kalashnikov PKM 7.62x54R machine gun
items.desc: PKM (Pulemyot Kalashnikova Modernizirovanny - "Kalashnikov's Machine Gun Modernized") is a modernized version of Kalashnikov PK machine gun, operating with 7.62x54R ammunition. The PKM proved to be a powerful, simple, reliable and effective weapon. It was in demand for many decades, starting from the late 60s of the last century and up to the present time. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.

items.name: Kalashnikov PKP 7.62x54R infantry machine gun
items.desc: The 7.62 mm PKP "Pecheneg" is widely recognized for its reliability and firepower. Time-tested technical solutions, skillfully combined with advanced approaches to ergonomics, made it possible to increase not only the mobility of the shooter on the battlefield, but also the accuracy of fire at a distance of up to 1500 m, eliminating the effect of thermal mirage by equipping the machine gun with an over-barrel transport grip.

items.name: KBP 9A-91 9x39 compact assault rifle
items.desc: The 9A-91 is a compact 9x39mm caliber assault rifle designed as a more technologically advanced analog and competitor of the SR-3 "Vikhr" assault rifle. Manufactured by Tula KBP Instrument Design Bureau.

items.name: KBP VSK-94 9x39 rifle
items.desc: The VSK-94 (Voyskovoy Snayperskiy Kompleks - "Military Sniper Complex") is a marksman rifle designed on the base of the 9A-91 assault rifle as a cheaper alternative to the VSS "Vintorez". The silencer, unlike the VSS, is not integrated, which allows the rifle to be used without it if needed. Manufactured by Tula KBP Instrument Design Bureau.

items.name: KEKTAPE duct tape
items.desc: KEKTAPE will not be able to patch up your difficult Tarkov fate, but it will be able to fix a boat. Or close up a hole in the aquarium. There are lots of things KEKTAPE can do.

items.name: Kel-Tec RFB 7.62x51 rifle
items.desc: The Kel-Tec RFB (Rifle, Forward-ejection, Bullpup) is a gas-operated bullpup type semi-automatic rifle, manufactured by Kel-Tec. Chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO/.308 Winchester ammunition. The RFB uses metric FAL magazines, which insert straight into the magazine well and do not need to rock into place. The weapon is fully ambidextrous, much in the style of the Belgian F2000 rifle. The RFB is delivered without iron sights. A mil-spec Picatinny rail is provided for mounting a wide range of optics and tactical accessories.

items.name: Key case
items.desc: This case is the ultimate solution to the problem of hoarding various keys in the stash, helping to store them in one place.

items.name: Key tool
items.desc: A special tool for storing all your keys in one convenient place.

items.name: Keycard holder case
items.desc: A special small case for storing plastic cards, including key cards.

items.name: Khorovod armband
items.desc: An armband by which the participants of the Khorovod can recognize each other. Without it, you cannot be part of the celebration.

items.name: Kiba Arms 25mm accessory ring mount
items.desc: A universal platform for installation of 25mm tactical accessories on Picatinny mounts.

items.name: Kiba Arms Short Mount sight adapter
items.desc: Short Mount is a universal mount for installation of Kiba Arms manufactured prism scope.

items.name: Kiba Arms Short Prism 2.5x scope
items.desc: The Short Prism 2.5x magnification scope, manufactured by Kiba Arms. The low magnification and bright illuminated reticle allow for fast both-eyes-open shooting at close range.

items.name: Kiba Arms SPRM rail mount for pump-action shotguns
items.desc: The universal SPRM 13-position rail mount by Kiba Arms International, for attaching additional devices to pump-action shotguns.

items.name: Kiba Arms Steel ballistic plate
items.desc: An armored steel plate for torso front and back pouches of plate carrier.

items.name: Kiba Arms Tactical Tomahawk
items.desc: A tactical tomahawk, multitool and breaching tool, all-in-one solution.

items.name: Kiba Arms Titan ballistic plate
items.desc: A titanium plate for torso front and back pouches of plate carrier.

items.name: Killa figurine
items.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Killa loves hardbass, three stripes and is waiting to meet you at the mall. Tarko's swaggiest figure, and whoever said otherwise, has been missing ever since. The figurine is rumored to be made of the same material as his helmet.

items.name: Kinda cowboy hat
items.desc: Yeeeeeeee-haaaaaaaaaaaaw! Or not...

items.name: KITECO SC-IV SA ballistic plate
items.desc: A UHMWPE plate for torso front and back pouches of plate carrier.

items.name: Kiver-M face shield
items.desc: A special faceshield for the FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet, made out of heavy-duty glass.

items.name: KMZ 1P59 3-10x riflescope
items.desc: The 1P59 "Giperon" pancratic sight is designed to increase the effectiveness of firing from SVD in comparison with the standard PSO-1 sight by 1.3-2 times (depending on the range and size of the target) due to a larger zoom, the use of a more accurate range finder, combining target ranging and sighting angle input operations, as well as the sighting angle input scale incorporated within the field of view of the sight.

items.name: KMZ 1P59 dovetail mount
items.desc: A universal base with an integrated power supply for installation of the 1P59 scope on the Dovetail rail.

items.name: KMZ 1P59 scope eyecup
items.desc: A rubber eyecup for the KMZ 1P59 scope.

items.name: KMZ 1P69 3-10x riflescope
items.desc: The 1P69 "Giperon" pancratic sight is a further development of the "Giperon" sights and is intended for installation on the SV-98 sniper rifle in order to increase the effectiveness on the battlefield. The sight has a flexible adjustment multiples, as well as a fairly accurate range finder, facilitating the operation of combining, measuring the distance to the target and entering the aiming angles.

items.name: KMZ 1P69 Weaver mount
items.desc: A universal base with an integrated power supply for installation of the 1P69 scope on the "Weaver" type rails.

items.name: Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle
items.desc: The SR-25 Precision Rifle is the latest evolution of the precision 7.62mm NATO semi-automatic rifle. An ambidextrous bolt release, selector, and magazine release offers the left-handed user the ergonomic advantages inherent to AR-15 based controls, as well as giving right-handed users alternate methods of manipulation to increase efficiency of movement. The Drop-In 2-Stage Trigger serves as an aid to long range precision marksmanship. The E2 bolt and gas system provides superior reliability in function whether suppressed or unsuppressed.

items.name: Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle (Taupe)
items.desc: The SR-25 Precision Rifle is the latest evolution of the precision 7.62mm NATO semi-automatic rifle. An ambidextrous bolt release, selector, and magazine release offers the left-handed user the ergonomic advantages inherent to AR-15 based controls, as well as giving right-handed users alternate methods of manipulation to increase efficiency of movement. The Drop-In 2-Stage Trigger serves as an aid to long range precision marksmanship. The E2 bolt and gas system provides superior reliability in function whether suppressed or unsuppressed. Coated in cerakote Taupe color.

items.name: Kolpak-1S face shield
items.desc: A weak protection from eye and face damage, made to mount on Kolpak-1S helmet.

items.name: Kolpak-1S riot helmet
items.desc: Kolpak-1S protects the head from the cold piercing-cutting weapons in a special class of protection GOST R50744-95, from fragmentation with an energy of impact up to 50 J, and also serves to reduce the dynamic loads arising from the above-mentioned means of destruction. Kolpak-1 protective helmets are recommended by the Interdepartmental Commission for equipping units of the patrol service, traffic police, OMON and other special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia.

items.name: KOMZ Rusak reflex sight
items.desc: A collimator sight manufactured by Kazan Optical-Mechanical Plant in the mid-90s for use on hunting weapons. Installed on the Dovetail type rail, adjustment only possible after full disassembly. Heavy, uncomfortable, foggy sight with horrible parallax - a real product of its time. However, it's still slightly more effective than shooting with iron sights.

items.name: Korund-VM ballistic plate (Back)
items.desc: An armored steel plate for torso rear pouch of 6b23-1, 6b23-2, Korund and Bagariy bulletproof vests.

items.name: Korund-VM ballistic plate (Side)
items.desc: Steel ballistic plate for side pouches of Russian bulletproof vests.

items.name: Korund-VM ballistic plates (Front)
items.desc: A combination of armored steel plates for torso front pouches of Russian bulletproof vests.

items.name: Korund-VM-K ballistic plate (Back)
items.desc: A ceramic plate for torso rear pouch of 6b23-1, 6b23-2, Korund and Bagariy bulletproof vests.

items.name: Korund-VM-K ballistic plates (Front)
items.desc: A combination of a big ceramic plate and small armored steel plate for torso front pouches of Russian bulletproof vests.

items.name: KOSA UAV electronic jamming device
items.desc: The device is designed to suppress UAV guidance systems. Helps to reliably protect any facility from airborne attacks.

items.name: Kotton beanie
items.desc: A knitted Kotton brand beanie. Warm and faaaaancy.

items.name: KP-SR2 sight shade
items.desc: A sight shade for the KP-SR2 reflex sight. Protects the lens against mechanical impacts and suppresses flaring. Manufactured by TsNIItochmash.

items.name: KRISS Defiance low profile flip-up front sight
items.desc: The Defiance detachable low profile flip-up front sight, installed on the mount. Manufactured by KRISS.

items.name: KRISS Defiance low profile flip-up rear sight
items.desc: The Defiance detachable low profile flip-up rear sight, installed on the mount. Manufactured by KRISS.

items.name: KRISS Vector .45 ACP 5 inch barrel
items.desc: A 5 inch (140mm) barrel for the KRISS Vector .45 ACP submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector .45 ACP 6 inch barrel
items.desc: A 6 inch (170mm) barrel for the KRISS Vector .45 ACP submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector .45 ACP flash hider
items.desc: A standard-issue flash hider for the KRISS Vector .45 ACP SMG.

items.name: KRISS Vector .45 ACP thread protector
items.desc: A thread protector cap for the KRISS Vector .45 ACP barrel.

items.name: KRISS Vector 9x19 5 inch barrel
items.desc: A 5 inch (140mm) threaded barrel for the KRISS Vector 9x19 submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector 9x19 6 inch barrel
items.desc: A 6 inch (170mm) threaded barrel for the KRISS Vector 9x19 submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector 9x19 flash hider
items.desc: A standard-issue flash hider for the KRISS Vector 9x19 SMG.

items.name: KRISS Vector 9x19 thread protector
items.desc: A thread protector cap for the KRISS Vector 9x19 barrel.

items.name: KRISS Vector bottom rail
items.desc: A bottom rail for the KRISS Vector submachine gun, allows installation of tactical foregrips and accessories.

items.name: KRISS Vector Gen.2 folding stock
items.desc: A 2nd generation folding stock for the KRISS Vector submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector Mk.5 modular rail
items.desc: The Mk.5 modular system allows you to install additional equipment on the handguard.

items.name: KRISS Vector non-folding stock adapter
items.desc: A non-folding adapter for the installation of telescopic stock buffer tubes on the KRISS Vector submachine gun.

items.name: KRISS Vector Pistol Sling adapter
items.desc: A pistol sling adapter for the KRISS Vector SMG.

items.name: KRISS Vector side rail
items.desc: A side rail for the KRISS Vector submachine gun, allows installation of additional tactical equipment.

items.name: KS-23 23x75 510mm barrel
items.desc: A 510mm long barrel for the KS-23 23x75mm pump-action shotgun.

items.name: KS-23 23x75 700mm barrel
items.desc: A 700mm long barrel for the KS-23 23x75mm pump-action shotgun.

items.name: KS-23 wooden stock
items.desc: A wooden stock for the KS-23 shotgun with a rubber butt-plate.

items.name: KS-23M 23x75 3-shell magazine cap
items.desc: A 3-shell capacity magazine cap for KS-23M 23x75mm shells.

items.name: KS-23M forestock
items.desc: A standard-issue polymer forestock made for the KS-23M shotgun.

items.name: KS-23M pistol grip
items.desc: A polymer pistol grip for the KS-23M shotgun, manufactured by TOZ.

items.name: KS-23M wire stock
items.desc: A steel wired stock for the KS-23M shotgun, manufactured by TOZ.

items.name: L1 (Norepinephrine) injector
items.desc: A sterile disposable syringe with a dose of L1, based on norepinephrine. It is used for short-term increase of strength and endurance, as well as to reduce the pain effect. This activates the implementation of a physiological response such as "hit or run". Increases water and energy consumption.

items.name: L3Harris AN/PEQ-15 tactical device
items.desc: The Advanced Target Pointer Illuminator Aiming Laser (ATPIAL) produced by L3 Technologies is a rugged, combat-proven and easy-to-use aiming system with integrated infrared and visible aim lasers as well as an infrared illuminator.

items.name: L3Harris AN/PEQ-15 tactical device (Black)
items.desc: The Advanced Target Pointer Illuminator Aiming Laser (ATPIAL) produced by L3 Technologies is a rugged, combat-proven and easy-to-use aiming system with integrated infrared and visible aim lasers as well as an infrared illuminator. Black version.

items.name: L3Harris AN/PVS-14 night vision monocular
items.desc: The AN/PVS-14 monocular night vision device for army/navy that allows nighttime detection of targets on distances of up to 350m with 40° FOV and has an adjustable brightness.

items.name: L3Harris GPNVG-18 night vision goggles
items.desc: The GPNVG-18 (Ground Panoramic Night Vision Goggle) panoramic night vision goggles. The cardinal difference of this NVG from the others is the presence of four separate image intensifier tubes, two for each eye. Two Central IITs are directed forward, while two more are directed outward from the center. This innovative solution allowed to expand the field of view to 97 degrees.

items.name: L3Harris LA-5B/PEQ tactical device
items.desc: ATPIAL (Advanced Target Pointer Illuminator Aiming Laser) LA-5B/PEQ produced by L3 Insight Technologies. Tactical device that combines laser designators in both visible and IR band with IR searchlight.

items.name: L3Harris NGAL tactical device
items.desc: The Next Generation Aiming Laser manufactured by L3 Insight Technologies. A tactical device that combines laser designators in both visible and IR band with IR searchlight.

items.name: L3Harris PVS-31A night vision goggles
items.desc: A very lightweight and ergonomic night vision device manufactured by L3Harris. Provides an optimal field of view and a clear image not only in low-light conditions but also in the presence of bright light sources. Equipped with Butler Creek flip-open lens protectors. White Phosphor tubes version.

items.name: Labrys research notes
items.desc: The documents are encrypted, but appear to contain research notes on some kind of technology or weapon. The records mention the name “Item 1156”.

items.name: Labyrinth facility research report
items.desc: Voronenko's report details the experiments TerraGroup conducted on humans in The Labyrinth.

items.name: Lantac BMD 7.62x51 Blast Mitigation Device
items.desc: The BMD Blast Mitigation Device by Lantac is a unique blast shield that allows the muzzle brake contained inside it to continue to function as normal with regard to muzzle climb mitigation. Installed on 7.62x51 caliber weapons.

items.name: Lantac BMD Blast Mitigation Device A3 direct thread adapter
items.desc: The A3 adapter by Lantac designed for installation of the BMD Blast Mitigation Device.

items.name: LaRue LT101 QD Tactical Picatinny Riser mount
items.desc: A Quick-Detach Picatinny riser to elevate the reflex or optical sight position, manufactured by LaRue.

items.name: LBT-1476A 3Day Pack (MultiCam Alpine)
items.desc: A medium-size 3-day backpack designed for both military and tourist use. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam Alpine version.

items.name: LBT-1476A 3Day Pack (Woodland)
items.desc: A medium-size 3-day backpack designed for both military and tourist use. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.

items.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (AOR1)
items.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. AOR1 version for the true Seals.

items.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (DNC)
items.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. Desert Night Camouflage version.

items.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (Goons Edition)
items.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. Special configuration by Birdeye, member of the Goons squad.

items.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (MAS Grey)
items.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.

items.name: LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (MultiCam)
items.desc: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam version.

items.name: LBT-2670 Slim Field Med Pack (Black)
items.desc: A low-profile medical backpack, designed to carry large amounts of specialized medical equipment and supplies. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.

items.name: LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)
items.desc: A simple yet effective plate carrier by London Bridge Trading company. The most minimalistic design intended for use with chest rigs. Black version.

items.name: LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan)
items.desc: A simple yet effective plate carrier by London Bridge Trading company. The most minimalistic design intended for use with chest rigs. Coyote Tan version.

items.name: LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Olive Drab)
items.desc: A simple yet effective plate carrier by London Bridge Trading company. The most minimalistic design intended for use with chest rigs. Olive Drab version.

items.name: LBT-8005A Day Pack backpack (MultiCam Black)
items.desc: A simple and reliable 14-liter backpack in MultiCam Black camouflage. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading.

items.name: Leapers UTG 25mm ring scope mount
items.desc: A low-profile 25.4mm ring mount for installation of various optics, manufactured by Leapers Inc.

items.name: Leapers UTG reflex sight
items.desc: The UTG reflex sight with a Red/Green circle dot, manufactured by Leapers Inc. This model is a compact, small-size reflex sight, which mounts on Weaver/Picatinny rails.

items.name: Leapers UTG Universal Shotgun Barrel Mount
items.desc: The UTG Universal Shotgun Barrel Mount is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-25 millimeters. Features 3 rails for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Leapers Inc.

items.name: Leather cap
items.desc: A respected gentleman's headdress. Protects the head from slander.

items.name: Leatherman Multitool
items.desc: With this compact and versatile multitool there is no need to be worried about having no tools on you at the right time.

items.name: Lebedev PL-15 9x19 pistol
items.desc: A Russian self-loading pistol chambered in 9x19mm, developed by a team of designers from the Kalashnikov concern under the leadership of Dmitry Lebedev for the needs of Russian law enforcement agencies.

items.name: LEDX Skin Transilluminator
items.desc: A medical device designed to accurately determine the position of the veins under the skin.

items.name: Left half of a Physical Bitcoin
items.desc: The left half of the physical equivalent of the Bitcoin cryptocurrency. It's unclear who decided to destroy an entire fortune and why.

items.name: Lega Medal
items.desc: A medal with the Legendary Kill mark. An extremely rare reward for Arena gladiators, which can be earned by completing Ref's hardest challenges.

items.name: Leshy's diary
items.desc: Notes from Leshy, detailing his mapping of The Labyrinth and reports on events following the assault.

items.name: Leshy's orders
items.desc: A note containing an order from a commander known as Leshy.

items.name: Letter from Kozlov's room
items.desc: A letter from Kozlov's room that he never managed to send.

items.name: Letter from Reshala's bunkhouse
items.desc: A letter taken from courier Pasha by Reshala’s people.

items.name: Letter from the mailbox
items.desc: A letter from Kozlov that has been sitting in the mailbox.

items.name: Leupold DeltaPoint Reflex Sight
items.desc: The DeltaPoint compact reflex sight by Leupold knows almost no limits in the range of application. Originally designed for use on pump-action shotguns in competitions and practical shooting, it was recognized for good performance on a wide range of weapons. From shotguns and handguns to AR-based rifles, as a main or auxiliary sight, it will show excellent results.

items.name: Leupold Mark 4 HAMR 4x24 DeltaPoint hybrid assault scope
items.desc: The Hybrid Leupold-produced scope comprises of the Mark 4 HAMR 4x24mm optical sight with the DeltaPoint reflex sight installed on top of it. It was developed for precision mid-range carbine fire using the 4x optics while being equally effective in close quarters thanks to use of compact reflex sight when necessary.

items.name: Leupold Mark 4 LR 6.5-20x50 30mm riflescope
items.desc: Precise, accurate, durable and dependable - the Leupold Mark 4 6.5-20x50 rifle scope. The model provides 6.5 - 20x magnification giving you a clear idea of the actual size of the targeted object.

items.name: Leupold Mark 4 MR/T TS-30A2 2.5-8x36 30mm riflescope
items.desc: Precise, accurate, durable and dependable - the Mark 4 MR/T TS-30A2 rifle scope. The model provides 2.5-8x magnification giving you a clear idea of the actual size of the targeted object.

items.name: Leupold Mark 5HD 5-25x56mm 35mm riflescope (FDE)
items.desc: The Mark 5HD 5-25x56 riflescope is known for being a lighter and more efficient optic than other scopes in its class. Featuring optical glass, full multi-coated lenses and an advanced light management system, the scope offers low-glare, high-contrast imaging. Installed on 35mm ring mounts. Manufactured by Leupold. Flat Dark Earth version.

items.name: Leupold Mark IMS 35mm ring scope mount
items.desc: A 35mm scope mount for installation on Picatinny rails. Manufactured by Leupold.

items.name: Light bulb
items.desc: A classic incandescent lamp. Fragile, often burns out, shines dimly, and consumes a lot of electricity.

items.name: Mark of The Unheard

When in the area of low intensity combat zone (PvE), the user of the device becomes visible in Fence's agent network. However, using this device, you have to follow his rules. Fence pays half of the money spent in the raid and coordinates the Scavs when searching for the user's lost equipment. If trusted enough by Fence, the user will not be attacked by Scavs as long as they keep their distance and show no aggression. In return, Fence requires to minimize damage to Scavs, and if the death of a Scav could not be avoided - to reduce the number of interference with his activities in the face of other PMCs in the area of the incident.

items.desc: The MSA Millennium Riot Control gas mask combines protection against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats with excellent build quality and a level of comfort rarely found in gas masks.

items.name: MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset
items.desc: The Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset amplifies low-level sounds while suppressing impulse noises. Water resistant for outdoor usage.

items.desc: An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or they already knew what would happen.

items.name: Mystery Ranch 2 Day Assault Pack (Black)
items.desc: This Mystery Ranch backpack is designed for short missions of up to two days. Its compact size is offset by excellent ergonomics. External straps provide convenient attachment points for tools and gear you might need on the go.

items.name: Mystery Ranch Blackjack 50 backpack (MultiCam)
items.desc: A backpack made for long and successful raids, manufactured by Mystery Ranch.

items.name: Mystery Ranch NICE COMM 3 BVS frame system (Coyote)
items.desc: The NICE Frame special system for carrying oversized or heavy loads with an installed COMM 3 backpack for carrying radio systems. The COMM 3 main bay is designed for PRC117F or G, PRC119F, 152, or ASIP radios. The Hitchhiker and Daypack lid allows you to carry separate gear if needed. The modular NICE COMM 3 system is ready to adapt to changing tasks. An extremely rare thing, for which a real hunt is conducted in Tarkov.

items.name: Mystery Ranch NICE Frame Load Sling
items.desc: The Load Sling by Mystery Ranch allows to carry heavy, irregularly shaped cargo. Its strap system secures items safely and reliably, while the external MOLLE straps provide versatile attachment points for smaller gear. This particular model is equipped with a spacious case offering extra protection.

items.name: Mystery Ranch SATL Bridger Assault Pack (Foliage)
items.desc: The Mystery Ranch SATL assault backpack has been the standard gear for SOCOM assault operations for nearly a decade. It now features a removable BVS system and a redirect waist belt for effective weight distribution, even when the backpack is worn over body armor.

items.name: Mystery Ranch Terraframe backpack (Christmas Edition)
items.desc: Someone has decorated the standard Terraframe model for Christmas. The weight hasn't changed much, but going into a raid has become somehow... more cheerful?

items.name: Mystery Ranch Terraframe backpack (Olive Drab)
items.desc: A comfortable and spacious backpack for its volume, it remained popular even in wartime. Judging by the attached antlers, this backpack used to belong to a hunter.

items.name: Nailhead figurine
items.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. What's more strange: the pale skin or the nails stuck in his head? It looks like this poor guy has experienced the full spectrum of human pain.

items.name: NB MOD.4 Kit 3.5 inch rail

items.name: NcSTAR MPR45 Backup mount
items.desc: A universal mount by NcStar that allows installing an auxiliary sight at 45 degrees angle.

items.name: NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser
items.desc: A compact tactical Laser Aiming Module with a blue dot. Mounts on any Picatinny/Weaver rail for precise target acquisition. Manufactured by NcSTAR.

items.name: Neoprene mask
items.desc: Neoprene light mask for the face with a creative image of a fiery flame. With such a mask, you're not just cool, you're dangerous.

items.name: Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house
items.desc: A newspaper clipping featuring an article about the NGO Cobalt. It seems the cultists took a great interest in this organization.

items.name: Newspaper clipping with a photo of Anastasia
items.desc: It seems Kozlov left a message on the back of the photograph.

items.name: NewSphereTech level III ballistic plate

items.name: NFM HJELM helmet (Hellhound Grey)

items.name: NFM THOR Concealable Reinforced Vest body armor
items.desc: The THOR Concealable Reinforced Vest enables the overt or covert carrying of soft ballistic panels providing 360 degrees protection against high-speed fragments and handgun ammunition. Adding hard ballistic plates enables protection against rifle ammunition for the vital organs. The ergonomic shape of the soft ballistic panels and the position of the back plate combined with the integrated lumbar support belt provides comfort and stability close to the body’s center of mass. Manufactured by NFM.

items.name: NFM THOR Concealable Reinforced Vest body armor (Head Eyes)
items.desc: A low-profile body armor manufactured by NFM. A version for those who really feel the Tarkov atmosphere.

items.name: NFM THOR Integrated Carrier body armor
items.desc: The THOR full protection assault body armor equipped with soft and hard armor elements to protect against shrapnel and bullets of pistol and rifle calibers. Manufactured by NFM.

items.name: Nightforce ATACR 7-35x56 34mm riflescope
items.desc: The NightForce ATACR 7-35x56 versatile scope with an extensive magnification range and a wide field-of-view across the entire range making it easy to see and engage targets.

items.desc: Nightforce X-Treme Duty Ultralite one piece Magmount is a universal 34mm scope base mount for installation on Picatinny rails. Comes attached with the Ruggedized Accessory Platform (RAP) for installing additional tactical devices and reflex sights.

items.name: NIXXOR lens
items.desc: A lens for video equipment and security systems.

items.name: NKVD Finka knife

Originally used as a utility tool and, when necessary, in combat, the Finka earned a reputation for simplicity and reliability. Its design provides a comfortable, secure grip. Today, it serves more as a collectible piece than a practical weapon.

items.name: Nooby Shield potassium iodide tablets
items.desc: In small doses, potassium iodide is used to treat thyroid disorders and is widely available. Larger doses of 65 mg and above are rare, typically reserved for nuclear accident response operations. Usually stored at nuclear facilities or held by military and emergency services.

items.name: Norinco long rail
items.desc: A long rail for standard-issue Norinco QBZ-191 assault rifle handguards. Allows installation of front grips.

items.name: Norinco QBZ-191 5.8x42 assault rifle
items.desc: A Chinese 5.8x42 assault rifle developed by Norinco as the successor to the QBZ-95. Featuring a conventional layout, fully ambidextrous controls, and a full-length optics rail, it was designed to improve ergonomics, modularity, and overall combat effectiveness.

items.name: Norinco QMK-171A 3x scope
items.desc: A fixed 3x optical sight manufactured by Norinco. Its low magnification and brightly illuminated reticle allow for fast, both-eyes-open target engagement at close range.

items.name: Norinco QMK-171A sight mount

items.name: Norinco short rail

items.name: Norinco VQX-191 5.8x42 sound suppressor

items.name: Norotos Titanium Advanced Tactical Mount
items.desc: A lightweight titanium mount for installation on the Shroud connector on the helmet. It is necessary for further installation of the night vision goggles or other optical devices. Manufactured by Norotos Inc.

items.name: Note about the Eye of the World
items.desc: A cultist's note mentioning something called the Eye of the World.

items.name: Note at the seaport door
items.desc: A note left by someone from the garrison at the port terminal.

items.name: Note by Item #1156
items.desc: A note left by one of the engineers in the workshop next to Item #1156.

items.name: Note for Kozlov
items.desc: A threatening note left on the door.

items.name: Note from Mr. Kerman
items.desc: A note with a warning from an unknown sender.

items.name: Note from Prapor's men
items.desc: The note mentions the delivery of some goods near the lighthouse.

items.name: Note from the repair shop
items.desc: A crumpled note stained with machine oil.

items.name: Note from USEC's corpse
items.desc: A note in which someone scolds a USEC operative for poor weapon maintenance.

items.name: Note mentioning General
items.desc: This cultists' note mentions the General, as well as the Lighthouse Warden.

items.name: Note mentioning Item #1156
items.desc: A handwritten note left in the open workspace of the TerraGroup laboratory.

items.name: Note mentioning Prapor
items.desc: The note mentions Yastreb and preparations for the ambush on the Bogatyr squad. It seems Prapor was somehow involved in the operation.

items.name: Note on preparations for the Arrival
items.desc: A torn notebook page detailing preparations for the Arrival.

items.name: Note with a warning
items.desc: A note from a certain Nagano'98.

items.name: Note with an address
items.desc: A note from Reshala's crew mentioning Kozlov's address.

items.name: Note with code word Adaptation
items.desc: There's only one word on the note: “Adaptation”. Looks like a code word. If someone found a new exfil route out of the TerraGroup HQ area, they must have placed their men nearby to keep anyone from the outside from getting to the new exit. In that case, the code would help distinguish friend from foe.

items.name: Note with code word Ark
items.desc: The word “Ark” hardly needs to be taken literally. It's more like a code word. There are quite a few locked doors under the Polikhim Factory, leading deeper into the catacombs. Perhaps someone will open the door for you if you know the code word.

items.name: Note with code word Heartbeat
items.desc: Someone wrote the word “Heartbeat” on a torn piece of paper. Sounds like one of Sanitar's weird pranks. Or perhaps a code word? If his men have their own exfil routes off Shoreline, they must be using a system of key phrases or signals. Maybe this note will make you look like one of their own.

items.name: Note with code word Onyx
items.desc: “Onyx”. If it's not a random scribble, then it's some kind of code. Perhaps one of the Scavs has found a new exfil route out of the city, but only allows access to their own. In a densely built environment, a reliable escape route must be underground.

items.name: Note with code word Voron
items.desc: It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?

items.name: Note with ramblings about the Purification
items.desc: A blank TerraGroup sheet with a rough scribble. Doesn't resemble the handwriting of office staff.

items.name: NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR)
items.desc: In the second millennium, the equipment of a soldier received serious changes in view of new threats and tasks. A better level of protection was required, so the Russian army needed a reliable and functional body armor. In the mid-2000s, the MVD, which was later reorganized into the Russian Guard, received Bagariy bulletproof vests. items.name: PNV-10T dovetail adapter
items.desc: The most common problem for owners of PNV-10T is its installation on modern helmets and suspension systems. The problem is solved by a simple adapter made of metal produced by many "workshops".

items.name: PNV-10T night vision goggles

items.name: PNV-57E night vision goggles
items.desc: Despite the fact that this model was manufactured in the 80s, the Soviet quality is still evident. The picture might not be as good as gen 2 or gen 3 night vision, but it's definitely worth its price.

items.name: Pointy guy figurine
items.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. This funny little character is wearing something like a pyramid on his head. A character like this could only exist in a fictional world, along with zombies and other monsters.

items.name: Police cap
items.desc: A Tarkov police cap, ususally worn by patrol units.

items.name: Politician Mutkevich figurine
items.desc: The Tarko collectible figure of a politician called Mutkevich. The unknown craftsman was impressed with how the former politician and current fighter of the Arena cleanup crew from is fighting for his life.

items.name: Pompon hat
items.desc: A warm hat with a pompon. Only Scavs would wear something like this. Well, or some psychos who want to be in the spotlight.

items.name: Portable defibrillator
items.desc: Sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) can happen to anyone, anytime, anywhere. Phipils uses SMART Biphasic technology in its HeartStart Defibrillators to deliver an effective, high current defibrillation shock at a lower energy dose to minimize side effects.

items.name: Portable Powerbank

items.name: Poster tube

Manufactured by Sureshot Armament Group.

This submachine gun has a simple but effective design. Its light weight makes it more comfortable to carry without affecting its performance, and it provides a high rate of fire without affecting its recoil. Thanks to these characteristics, it's still used as a service weapon in almost all Russian law enforcement agencies.

items.name: TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun
items.desc: The KRISS Vector SMG is the ideal choice for law enforcement and military seeking a controllable and compact weapon system for close quarter combat environments. items.name: TheAKGuy AK-50 .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle
items.desc: The AK-50 semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle is an experimental first-of-a-kind project that adapts the Kalashnikov platform to use the .50 BMG cartridge. The AK-50 has outstanding penetration and range, making it a very powerful sniper rifle. This prototype was developed by a firearms manufacturer and YouTube blogger Brandon Herrera and co. as part of The AK Guy LTD.

items.name: Therapist figurine
items.desc: This limited Tarko figurine depicts Therapist, ready to save a few unfortunate souls. Or take your money for questionable medical services.

items.name: Thunder Beast Arms Ultra 5 sound suppressor
items.desc: The Ultra 5 sound suppressor is designed for use with 7.62x51 NATO rounds, but also functions as a superb multi-caliber suppressor for multiple hosts, providing excellent performance on 7.62 NATO, .300, 6.8 SPC, 6.5, and 5.56mm NATO. Can only be installed on compatible muzzle devices made by Thunder Beast Arms.

items.desc: The TKPD (Tyazhelyy Karabin Podderzhki Dragunova - "Dragunov Heavy Support Carbine") is a modernized SVDK chambered in 9.3x64mm, commissioned by PMC BEAR. The weapon is noted for high accuracy and effectively suppresses targets at medium ranges. Manufactured by SniperArms Dynamics.

items.name: TKPD 9.3x64 muzzle brake

items.name: Toilet paper

items.name: Tokarev AVT-40 7.62x54R automatic rifle
items.desc: The AVT-40 partially compensated for the lack of handguns and submachine guns at the beginning of WW2. The AVT-40 is similar to the SVT-40 in its design, but due to the presence of a fire selector, the role of which is played by the safety lever, it can fire both single and automatic fire.

items.name: Tokarev SVT-40 7.62x54R rifle
items.desc: The SVT-40 was the only mass-produced personal weapon in the early years of WW2, before the mass production of submachine guns began. The soldiers affectionately called this rifle "Sveta". When "Sveta" went to the troops, it turned out that not all Red Army soldiers were able to truly master this weapon. The SVT was best used by marine infantry units and snipers. The production of SVT-40 continued until the end of the war, and this semi-automatic rifle made an important contribution to the overall victory.

items.name: Tokarev TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol
items.desc: A legendary pistol that has seen numerous military conflicts throughout the years and is still in service in certain regions of the world, in one variation or another. This one is a classic TT-33, the most mass-produced version. It features a Browning short-recoil tilting-barrel system, but other than that, the construction design is very unique - it is purposefully simple, single-action, and no safety measures except half-cock notch, which makes it be able to withstand horrible operating abuse. Thanks to the powerful 7.62x25 cartridge and relatively long barrel, the TT boasts high muzzle velocity, penetration, and impressive accuracy, even over long distances.

items.name: Tokarev TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden)
items.desc: A legendary pistol that has seen numerous military conflicts throughout the years and is still in service in certain regions of the world, in one variation or another. This one is a classic TT-33, the most mass-produced version. It features a Browning short-recoil tilting-barrel system, but other than that, the construction design is very unique - it is purposefully simple, single-action, and no safety measures except half-cock notch, which makes it be able to withstand horrible operating abuse. Thanks to the powerful 7.62x25 cartridge and relatively long barrel, the TT boasts high muzzle velocity, penetration, and impressive accuracy, even over long distances. A special gold edition.

items.name: Toni System Tactical Barrel Clamp
items.desc: The Tactical Barrel Clamp is designed for mounting on tubular magazines and barrels with a diameter of 20-27 millimeters. Features a rail for attaching additional equipment. Manufactured by Toni System.

items.name: Toolbox (Discord Version)
items.desc: An ordinary toolbox with an unordinary color. Most of the stickers on it are inexistent in Tarkov. Someone has paid a hefty price to smuggle it from outside the cordon.

items.name: Toolset
items.desc: A repairman’s bag with a set of different tools.

items.name: Toothpaste
items.desc: Not that teeth hygiene is so essential in the city these days, but why not, if a chance is here.

items.name: Topographic survey maps
items.desc: A set of various maps of the area with applied schemes, which are of high value as reconnaissance materials.

items.name: Torrey Pines Logic T12W 30Hz thermal reflex sight
items.desc: A compact termal reflex sight with a low frequency. Manufactured by Torrey Pines Logic.

items.name: Toy gun 20x1mm 20-round magazine
items.desc: A standard disk magazine for the Soviet toy gun. Not recommended to load it with coins. Manufactured in the USSR.

items.name: TOZ KS-23M 23x75mm pump-action shotgun
items.desc: KS-23 is a Russian shotgun, although because it uses a rifled barrel it is officially designated by the Russian military as a carbine. KS stands for Karabin Spetsialniy, "Special Carbine". It is renowned for its large caliber, firing a 23 mm round, equating to 6.27 gauge using the British and American standards of shotgun gauges and approximately 4 gauge using the current European standards (based on the metric CIP tables), making it the largest-bore shotgun in use today.

items.name: TOZ Simonov SKS 7.62x39 carbine
items.desc: A Soviet semi-automatic carbine designed by Sergei Simonov for 7.62x39 cartridges and known abroad as SKS-45. Immensely popular both in CIS countries and in the West, this weapon is still in active service in some countries in form of various copies and modifications. This particular model comes from extended storage warehouses of Tula Arms Plant and haven't yet undergone the civilian weapon normalization procedure.

items.name: TOZ-106 002 pistol grip

items.name: TOZ-106 20ga bolt-action shotgun

items.desc: TP-200 is intended for use as charges in the production of seismic surveys, intermediate detonators when initiating borehole explosive charges, crushing oversized items and performing special blasting operations.

items.desc: A removable backup iron sight, installed on the ACOG TA01NSN 4x32 scopes. Manufactured by Trijicon.

items.name: Trijicon ACOG TA01NSN 4x32 scope (Black)
items.desc: Designed to the exact specifications of the US Special Operations Command for use by elite US forces, the Trijicon ACOG TA01NSN is Trijicon’s most popular ACOG. The ranging reticle allows for bullet drop compensation out to 600 meters without any manual adjustments. Additional backup rear sights can be mounted. No batteries needed. Black version.

items.name: Trijicon ACOG TA01NSN 4x32 scope (Tan)
items.desc: Designed to the exact specifications of the US Special Operations Command for use by elite US forces, the Trijicon ACOG TA01NSN is Trijicon’s most popular ACOG. The ranging reticle allows for bullet drop compensation out to 600 meters without any manual adjustments. Additional backup rear sights can be mounted. No batteries needed. Tan version.

items.name: Trijicon ACOG TA02 4x32 scope
items.desc: A fixed 4x combat optic with a rugged aluminum housing, designed for accurate target engagement at medium ranges. The TA02 features LED-powered illumination for reliable performance in varying lighting conditions. Manufactured by Trijicon.

items.name: Trijicon ACOG TA11D 3.5x35 scope
items.desc: The ACOG 3.5x35 riflescope manufactured by Trijicon. Still remains a favorite among competitive shooters, law enforcement and freedom-loving civilians from everywhere around the world.

items.name: Trijicon SRS-02 reflex sight
items.desc: The Trijicon SRS Sealed Reflex Sight is compact and takes up less rail space while maintaining durability and performance. The large 38mm aperture allows for a wide field of view and rapid target engagement. The Trijicon SRS Sealed Reflex Sight features a 1.75 MOA dot for precision. The SRS is powered by a solar cell and a single AA battery.

items.name: Trijicon TA51 sight mount

items.name: Trimadol stimulant injector

It has a central and spinal cord action (promotes opening of K+ and Ca2+ channels, causes hyperpolarization of membranes and inhibits conduction of pain impulses). In addition to the analgesic effect, it increases combat characteristics. Overdose leads to exhaustion of the body after the effects wear off.

items.name: Type 56 Chicom chest harness
items.desc: The Type 56 Chicom vest is the forefather of modern tactical loadout harness systems. The Type 56 rifle magazine chest harness was developed for the People's Liberation Army of China in the 1950s and has since been widely used in many local conflicts of the 20th century. In the early 1980s, such harnesses made their way to Afghanistan, where they gained acceptance by select Soviet troops who used the trophy Chicoms. It is unknown whether or not the Chicom served as a prototype for the Soviet Belt-A chest rig or not.

The M60 was nicknamed "The Pig" due to its bulky size and design flaws. Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance.

items.name: U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun

It can be widely applied in many RFID application systems such as logistics, access control, anti-counterfeit and industrial production process control system.

items.name: Walther MRS reflex sight
items.desc: The Walther MRS (Multi-Reticle Sight) reflex sight features 2 dots and 2 reticles with adjustable brightness levels. Cheap, accurate (but has to be zeroed every time the reticle type is switched), compact and offers good battery life - but not too sturdy and reliable.

items.name: WARTECH Berkut BB-102 backpack (A-TACS FG)
items.desc: A tactical backpack with front loading capabilities. Suitable for use by military and security forces, or for military tactical games. Manufactured in WARTECH.

items.name: WARTECH MK3 TV-104 chest rig (Moss)
items.desc: This chest rig platform is designed for placing equipment in the chest and abdomen areas, with an open back. Includes integrated pouches, designed for 8 magazines. Can be used both separately and on top of the armor vest. Manufactured by WARTECH. Moss camouflage version.

items.name: WARTECH MK3 TV-104 chest rig (MultiCam)

items.name: WARTECH TV-109 + TV-106 chest rig (A-TACS FG)
items.desc: The WARTECH gear rig consisting of the TV-106 Battle Belt and TV-109 heavy suspension system. The shoulder straps are reinforced with foam and have MOLLE straps, and the TV-109 combined with the TV-106 completes the belt system into a full-featured gear rig.

items.name: WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Coyote)
items.desc: The LBS TV-110 plate carrier equipped with a set of pouches. Manufactured by WARTECH.

items.name: WARTECH TV-115 plate carrier (Black)

items.name: WARTECH TV-115 plate carrier (Olive Drab)

items.desc: Initially, this agent was developed for industrial consumers as an anti-corrosive water repellent. It was later discovered that it also had plenty of domestic use applications. According to the legend, the product's formula was developed on the fortieth attempt (WD-40 as short for Water Displacement - 40th Attempt). The product consists mostly of various hydrocarbons.

items.name: WZ Wallet

items.name: Xenoalien figurine
items.desc: A limited edition Tarko figurine. Looks like a monster with a disproportionately elongated head and a double mouth. Totally "Alien" (good one) to the Tarko universe.

items.name: Xenomorph sealing foam
items.desc: Xenomorph is a sealing foam with an excellent structure of cells and high mechanical strength. Easy to use, applied with a thin applicator tube. Foam is an expandable material that doubles its volume on solidification. Has excellent adhesion to most building materials such as wood, concrete, stone, metal, etc. This product does not contain any chloro-fluoro-carbon propellants. A reliable and cost-effective solution for sealing and filling the voids.

items.name: xTG-12 antidote injector
items.desc: Removes most of the known poisons and toxins used in the combat industry. Can be used to relieve the effects of natural poisons. Gives immunity to poisoning while the components are in the blood system. Can reduce health status.

items.name: Yankee Hill Annihilator multi-caliber flash hider
items.desc: A multicaliber flash hider designed for the AR-15 platform, manufactured by Yankee Hill. Fits 7.62x51, 5.56x45, 9x19 barrels.

items.name: Yarygin MP-443 Grach 9x19 pistol
items.desc: The PYa MP-443 (Pistolét Yarýgina MP-443 - "Yarygin Pistol MP-443", GRAU Index - 6P35) widely known as "Grach" is a Russian semiautomatic pistol chambered in 9x19 mm. It was designed by Vladimir Yarygin in the 1990s and adopted as a standard sidearm by the Russian military, law enforcement agencies, and special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. It features a high capacity magazine and can be equipped with the Zenit B-8 mount to install additional attachments beneath the barrel.

items.name: Zagustin hemostatic drug injector
items.desc: A military-issue drug. Inhibits activators of profibrinolysin and slows down its transformation in fibrinolysin. Temporarily stops the bleeding and increases resistance to bloodloss. Has side effects. Leads to severe dehydration.

items.name: Zarya stun grenade
items.desc: Intended to suppress the mental stability by creating a sudden sound effect and a bright flash. Used in special operations for apprehension of criminals and in riot suppression.
